parsed.overall_notes: Practical sections (S3,S4,S6,S7) are overwhelmingly pre-scripted illustrative narratives built around the internal notebook's mock FAQs/customer queries, Mermaid diagrams, and Gemini code, explaining the high scripted_example_fraction. Theory draws from overlapping Anthropic-inspired sources on now-canonical patterns (prompt chaining, routing, orchestrator-workers), yielding low source_independence and high topic_canonicity that reduce further exploration value; argumentative risk is moderate only where 'why better' or 'when to use' normative leaps appear relative to source gaps.
